basic_info.description: Welcome to 28 Clayton Street, a bright and thoughtfully laid-out full-floor condo nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street in the heart of San Francisco. This spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath residence offers the perfect blend of comfort, flexibility, and location. The main level features two generously sized bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. The primary bedroom has direct access to a private deck, ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The light-filled living room and formal dining room flow seamlessly into the kitchen, which includes a dedicated laundry room for added convenience. Downstairs, a versatile third bedroom or home office opens to a second deck and a lush shared backyard, offering a serene setting for outdoor activities such as hosting guests or barbecuing with friends. Additional highlights include a deeded side-by-side parking space, shelves for storage, andlastlya functional bellcrank lever at the top of the stairs that pays homage to the period details of the early 20th century. Ideally located adjacent to USF and just two blocks from the Panhandle of Golden Gate Park, where there is a wonderful workout area and playground. The central location offers easy access to the vibrant Divisadero retail corridor, with cafes, restaurants, and shops just a short stroll away.
